outcome.technical: plugins/audit/hooks/_config.py: (1) git_place asks git a second time, for the fields alone, only when the refused combined question is a top git cannot give (_top_refused: a git directory stands at or above the directory before any .git entry - _git_dir_above, a locale-free disk fact - or git's refusal carries 'must be run in a work tree', _REFUSED_TOP) AND time is left of the caller's timeout; the retry gets only what is left (time.monotonic around the first ask). A timeout or an unrunnable git is asked once. Chosen over asking --is-bare-repository because that is a second process on exactly the paths (timeout, exception) the acceptance says must not ask twice. (2) One predicate, _holds_repository (a .git entry or the HEAD/objects/refs git-dir shape, _git_dir_shaped), is now read by both witnesses: _no_repository_above (refusals) and _inside_known_tree (answers, and _tree_of_dir's containment), so a bare repository made between a directory and its top drops the kept answer. _dot_git_identity for a .git directory now carries (st_ino, st_size, st_mtime_ns) of .git/config (one lstat), so core.bare/core.worktree changes drop the answer. Cost was judged acceptable, so the config identity is implemented, not merely documented; the block comment above _STANDING_FIELDS states the two limits that remain (a .git FILE's config in the common dir is not read; the shape test does not validate HEAD) and the retry rule, including that a translated git in a checkout configured bare is answered None. _DISCOVERY_ENV untouched. (3) standing_approval reads arm/revoke rows through _journal_io.last_words (loaded via journal_lib(), the hooks' existing path loader - hooks still import nothing from scripts/ at module scope); a revoking among the newest second's last words reads as not armed with revokedAt kept; arming rows alone keep the one read last; raises RuntimeError when the journal reader cannot be loaded (every caller already catches and reports 'could not be read'). tests/test__config.py: new st8, st9 (_git_place_ask_cases, stubbed _ask_rev_parse), st10, st11 (_git_witness_cases, real git fixtures, each first showing git's fresh answer moved), sp1 (_standing_tie_cases).
